# Mozzarella stretching

Mozzarella is a pasta filata cheese: the curd is heated until it stretches like taffy, then folded into smooth, glossy balls. Fresh milk and the right acidity from [[Cheese cultures]] make the curd stretch.

Dip the drained curd in water at 80 °C, then pull and fold it with gloved hands until it is elastic and shiny.

Tuck the stretched cheese into a ball, pinch it closed and drop it into cold salted water to firm up.

Serve it torn over warm bread from the [[Baking in a dutch oven|dutch oven]].
